# Nexlet Robotics

Nexlet Robotics specializes in advanced satellite imagery analytics tailored to the property insurance industry. Their flagship product, RoofSight, leverages AI-driven image processing to automate the assessment of roof conditions. This enables insurers to accelerate claims processing by quickly identifying damages such as wear, weather impact, or structural compromise from high-resolution satellite data, reducing the need for costly and time-consuming physical inspections.

RoofSight primarily serves the property insurance sector, focusing on regional and national insurers managing large property portfolios. As of early 2024, Nexlet Robotics has onboarded over 50 regional insurance firms across North America and Europe, collectively covering approximately 3 million residential and commercial properties. Customers report up to a 40% reduction in claims processing time and a 25% decrease in adjustment costs since integrating RoofSight into their workflows.

Founded in 2020, Nexlet Robotics secured a $15 million Series A funding round in Q3 2023, led by Orion Ventures and supported by UrbanTech Capital. The company is currently scaling its engineering team of 30, headquartered in the tech hub of Newhaven City. The core team combines expertise in remote sensing, AI, and insurance operations, with the CTO having previously developed satellite analytics tools for agricultural monitoring.

Key competitors include Stratify Analytics, GeoClaim Insights, and Veritas Imagery Solutions, each offering varying degrees of satellite-based claims support. Nexlet Robotics differentiates itself with proprietary roof-specific scoring algorithms and a user-friendly claims integration platform.

Open risks include satellite data availability during severe weather events, potential regulatory changes affecting remote property assessment, and reliance on third-party satellite providers which could impact data latency or coverage. The company is actively investing in multi-source data fusion and regulatory compliance initiatives to mitigate these risks.

Founder: [[people/marlow-thrumbrook]].
